title: North American Indian legends of six-fingered red-haired giants

tellings.quote: The North American Indians had legends of giants. Six-fingered red-haired giants, by the way.
The Native Americans had the had the legends of the red-haired giants

as_told.title: Native American legends of red-haired giants

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that Native American peoples had legends of giants with red hair and six fingers. At another point in the same conversation he mentions only the red-haired giants, without the six fingers. He tells it because, if true, these stories would point to a lost race of giants in North America.
